notes: Hanfield Street (name printed only as '...NIFIELD' at the strip's west edge) runs along the cut top edge of the plate: only its south side and the water pipe line are on the plate, so its centre is taken on the pipe line, about 105-115 px north of the south block edge; Florida, Kirby and Gordon show stubs running on north past it. Colerain Avenue is not named inside the strip; it is the 60 ft street with the car track and house numbers 4126-4226. Powers Street is not named inside the strip and is cut by the bottom edge of the plate: only its north side (y about 7110-7122) and a pipe line (y about 7178) show, centre estimated at y 7190 for a 50 ft street; whether Edgewood, Llewellyn and Borden continue south of it cannot be seen. Hoffner Avenue: printed 55 ft, edges read at y about 262-268 and 405-410; the streets from the south end at it (Wesleyan Cemetery to the north). Printed 'HOFFNER' with no suffix; Llewellyn, Borden, Kirby, Gordon, Florida printed 'ST.'. Nothing but cemetery, creek and unplatted land between y 2000 and 5250.
